name: CircleKit Community
author: Abdul Wahab Taqi

sections.description:
CircleKit Community adds core community features to WordPress. It includes member profiles, public groups, an activity feed, basic notifications, profile fields, email settings, widgets, and admin tools.

External Services

CircleKit Community uses WordPress avatar functions for fallback profile images. If a member has no community profile photo, WordPress may request a Gravatar image from Automattic’s Gravatar service. The request can include a hashed version of the member email address, the requested avatar size, and the visitor’s IP address and browser details as part of the image request. Gravatar’s privacy policy is available at https://automattic.com/privacy/ and Automattic’s terms of service are available at https://wordpress.com/tos/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/circlekit-community directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate CircleKit Community through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open CircleKit Community in the WordPress admin menu to configure pages, modules, profile fields, groups, emails, and styling.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require activation?

No. CircleKit Community is ready to use after WordPress activates the plugin.
